basis.statement: The ID algorithm derived an observational expression for P(Y | do(X)).
The expression uses the observed-variable projection of “GPS use, hippocampal volume and spatial memory”; bidirected edges represent the common causes recorded as unmeasured nodes.
The front-door two-stage estimator can evaluate this expression under its linear stage-model assumptions.
